title: Adjust structure node text size
description:
Structure Mode can now resize label text separately from the node circle. Use Placement text size for new nodes, or select nodes → right-click → Adjust node / text size for existing ones. CSS no longer locks text to a fixed 47px size.

Who is affected: PipeSync Plan View on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh Plan Sync (map37). Structure Mode → select nodes → Adjust node / text size.
changeLog: Add independent structure node text size (placement default + batch adjust).
Persist per-node fontSize and board default text size with plan view.
Stop CSS from forcing structure labels to a fixed font size.
